name: #TRUDOVYEBUDNI
source:
In pursuit of glory for the fame of the best game developer, you get transferred to a new school. But you end up in the enmity of two school clubs! And there is no easy way out of it…

[From [url=https://vkplay.ru/play/game/damnthatwork/]VK Play[/url]]

为了追求最佳游戏开发者的荣耀，你被转学到一所新学校。但你最终陷入了两个学校俱乐部的敌对之中！而且没有简单的方法可以摆脱它……

[来自[url=https://vkplay.ru/play/game/damnthatwork/]VK Play[/url]]
